verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth natively supports sign-in with external providers such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Discord. Providers that are not listed can be added through its Custom OAuth/OIDC Providers feature, and the docs state it works with any OAuth2/OIDC-compatible provider. Missing for 10: the full provider list is not enumerated, the configuration-only (no custom code) setup is only implied by the dashboard providers settings, there is no independent hands-on confirmation of the setup, and one community report says the OAuth client flow on React Native is convoluted.

support.subject: As a developer, I can offer sign-in with a broad set of social and OAuth identity providers through configuration, not custom code

citations.quote: Sign in with external providers (Google, Apple, Facebook, Discord, ...)
To add a provider that isn't listed, use [Custom OAuth/OIDC Providers](/docs/guides/auth/custom-oauth-providers).
It works with any OAuth2 or OIDC-compatible identity provider.
